title: Analytic: surface chi2 SHG at grazing incidence, linear growth (nonlinear FDFD)
description:
Surface second-harmonic generation (em_fdfd_nonlinear, surface_chi2): a y-periodic vacuum strip (period H = 200 nm, 20 rows of 10 nm, CPML along x); an H_z line source launches the pump (1550 nm, E_y = A_p along the full height), so the pump field is NORMAL to the horizontal top face of the surface layer, a rectangle y 0-100 nm over x_nl .. x_nl + L_nl with chi_s_nnn only (chi_s_ntt = chi_s_tnt = 0). interface_with = the one cell row above it keeps only that top face (not the periodic wrap at y = 0, whose opposite dipoles would cancel it, nor the vertical ends, where E_n = E_x = 0 anyway). P_s,n = (1/2) eps0 chi_s_nnn E_n^2 (selvedge inside) is a one-cell dipole layer P_y = P_s,n / h; its y-mean P_s,n / H drives the y-uniform SH wave, phase matched in vacuum (2 k), so the SH grows linearly with L_nl (swept 2-10 um); the higher y orders are evanescent (H below the 775 nm SH wavelength). Analytic: continuum |E_2w| = k0 chi_s_nnn A_p^2 L / (2 H) (the coupled-mode growth k_2w

L / (2 eps0)); the reference E_sh_ref is the exact 3-point lattice form: E_n = A_p cos(K_w h / 2) (the face-mean normal field), the face deposit's cos(K_w h), the face-lattice Green's function h^2 / (2 sin K_2w h) and the centre probe's cos(K_2w h / 2), times the vacuum lattice mismatch |sin(N dK / 2) / sin(dK / 2)| (dK = K_2w h - 2 K_w h ~ (k h)^3 / 4, negligible here); the two differ by ~0.1 %. Sweep tab: E_sh (forward |E_y| of the SH, ~1e6 V/m at 10 um) vs L_nl with the dashed lattice and continuum lines. Derived values tab: E_sh against E_sh_ref and E_p (the pump inside the layer region) against A_p cos(K_w h / 2); expected ~1e-3 (CPML floor; to be confirmed by a first run).

parameters.name: lam_p
parameters.description: pump vacuum wavelength

parameters.name: dx_cell
parameters.description: uniform cell size

parameters.name: H_per
parameters.description: periodic y period H (20 cells)

parameters.name: y_top
parameters.description: top face of the surface layer (a cell edge, normal +y)

parameters.name: k_vac
parameters.description: pump vacuum wavenumber k0 [1/m]

parameters.name: chi_nnn
parameters.description: surface chi_s_nnn [m^2/V]

parameters.name: A_p
parameters.description: pump E_y amplitude [V/m] the line source launches (on the faces)

parameters.name: x_src
parameters.description: pump line source (centre of cell 100)

parameters.name: x_nl
parameters.description: start of the surface layer (a cell edge)

parameters.name: L_nl
parameters.description: surface layer length (swept 2-10 um; whole cells)

parameters.name: x_mid
parameters.description: pump probe inside the layer region

parameters.name: x_fwd
parameters.description: forward SH probe (cell centre, 100 cells past the layer)

parameters.name: y_probe
parameters.description: probe row (a cell centre above the layer)

parameters.name: Lx
parameters.description: strip length (CPML on both x faces, outside the window)

parameters.name: K_p
parameters.description: vacuum lattice phase per cell of the pump

parameters.name: K_sh
parameters.description: vacuum lattice phase per cell of the SH

parameters.name: dK
parameters.description: vacuum lattice mismatch per cell (1.7e-5)

parameters.name: N_nl
parameters.description: layer cells along x

parameters.name: E_n
parameters.description: normal pump field at the cell centres [V/m]

parameters.name: C_tem
parameters.description: SH per layer column at the centre probe [V/m]

parameters.name: E_sh_ref
parameters.description: lattice forward |E_2w| [V/m]

parameters.name: E_sh_cont
parameters.description: continuum forward |E_2w| [V/m]
